extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.1 - Settings, a tab per area: Home page layout (BingeTV), Add-ons and manifests, Playback, Subtitles, Watch state, MDBList, IPTV (IPTV Simple's playlist and guide, Dispatcharr Bridge), Search, Expert, Kodi add-ons; with links to Kodi's own player, subtitle and add-on pages. Your settings carry over. v0.17.0 - For BingeTV's new skin: the player's Streams button picks another stream for what's playing and carries on where you were; autoplay skips a stream that turns out to be a short "can't play" clip and tries the next; the preparing page stays up from start to finish; a Home rows editor; extra hubs on the menu bar. Similar titles use your meta addon. Kodi 21 and Arctic Zephyr Stremio work as before.
